title: Hog Saga: The Good Boy
tagline: A pawsitively tiny RPG from PostHog

text.win: The Crashhound rolls over. Every walk gets booked and every sitter gets paid. Good dev!
text.lose: The bugs chewed up the booking flow. Have a treat at the inn and try again.
text.credits: Made with love (and dog puns) for Pawprint by PostHog

game.intro: Walks are going unbooked across Pawprint. Something is chewing through the app.

town.name: Barkside
town.inn_line: Paws up and rest. Biscuits are in the jar by the door.

regions.name: Walkies Woods
regions.blurb: Half the walks that start here never finish.

regions.name: Query Canyon
regions.blurb: Dry, dusty and full of SQL requests.

party.name: Pixel
party.sprite_prompt: a data analyst with glasses and a purple hoodie with a paw print

party.name: Biscuit
party.sprite_prompt: a cheerful pet sitter with an orange vest and a leash

npcs.name: Dog Walker
npcs.line: The app crashed mid-booking again. On Android. Again.
npcs.sprite_prompt: a dog walker holding three leashes and a phone

npcs.name: Pet Parent
npcs.line: I started booking a sitter, then got lost. Did it even go through?
npcs.sprite_prompt: a pet parent carrying a small fluffy dog

npcs.name: Data Team
npcs.line: Can you just pull me one quick query? Said everyone. Every day.
npcs.sprite_prompt: a tired data engineer surrounded by sticky notes

enemies.name: Android Flea
enemies.sprite_prompt: a tiny green flea with a cracked phone for a shell

enemies.name: Cart Dropper
enemies.sprite_prompt: a purple beetle running off with a tiny empty basket

enemies.name: Chew Toy Bug
enemies.sprite_prompt: a big orange bug chewing a squeaky bone

enemies.name: SQL Tick
enemies.pain: Just one more quick query, please.
enemies.sprite_prompt: a fat orange tick covered in sticky notes

enemies.name: Mystery Mutt
enemies.sprite_prompt: a ghostly grey dog made of question marks

boss.name: The Crashhound
boss.taunt: Who's a bad app? YOU'RE a bad app!
boss.phase2: GRRR! I'll crash every booking in town!
boss.sprite_prompt: a giant purple bulldog monster with a spiked collar and glowing eyes

product_lines.error_tracking: Fetch the Android crash, with stack
